MRI Safety Information
The Ember Spinal System is MR Conditional. Patients with this device can be scanned at 1.5 T when all of the following conditions are met.
General conditions:
- Spatial field gradient: ≤ 19 T/m (1,900 Gauss/cm).
- Scan in Normal Operating Mode or First Level Controlled Operating Mode.
- whole body SAR not to exceed 1.5 W/kg.
The image artifact extends approximately 20 mm from the device.
RF heating was evaluated using a body coil at 64 MHz and 128 MHz in a gel phantom.
Testing used a maximum gradient amplitude of 40 mT/m.
